text:
Which statement about addition polymers or condensation polymers is correct?
A
Addition polymers only contain carbon and hydrogen atoms.
B
One of the monomers used to make a polyester is a diamine.
C
Addition polymers contain carbon–carbon double bonds in the main chain.
D
Water is an additional product in the formation of a protein from amino acids.

options.label: A
options.text: Addition polymers only contain carbon and hydrogen atoms.

options.label: B
options.text: One of the monomers used to make a polyester is a diamine.

options.label: C
options.text: Addition polymers contain carbon–carbon double bonds in the main chain.

options.label: D
options.text: Water is an additional product in the formation of a protein from amino acids.
